name: Newt
description: Newt (https://github.com/fosrl/newt) is the tunneled site and network connector for Pangolin (https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin), the identity-based remote access platform. Chat with us on Discord! https://discord.gg/HCJR8Xhme4

variables.name: PANGOLIN_ENDPOINT
variables.description: This is the full URL of the Pangolin instance. Example: https://proxy.example.com

variables.name: NEWT_ID
variables.description: This is the unique ID of the Newt site. Example: 31frd0uzbjvp721

variables.name: NEWT_SECRET
variables.description: This is the secret key of the Newt site. Example: h51mmlknrvrwv8s4r1i210azhumt6isgbpyavxodibx1k2d6
